text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For ordinary Umamusume, summer camp is a time to improve their skills. But…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon, as usual, smiles with anticipation at the mountain of experiments that can only be done at this time of year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And thus begins our whirlwind of a summer camp!
